rating.verdict: A sweet, colorful pony deck for casual Modern nights. Lifelink ponies feed Celestial Unicorn and Crested Sunmare's 5/5 Horse tokens, but the creatures are mostly Standard-level commons and rares, so it's well behind Modern's tuned decks.
strengths: Lots of lifelink keeps you alive against aggro
Every life gain grows Celestial Unicorn and makes Crested Sunmare tokens
Good-Fortune Unicorn turns each new pony into a bigger one
weaknesses: Slow against Modern's fast combo decks
Sweepers wipe out a board of mid-size creatures

wins: Build a herd of lifelink ponies, gain life every turn, and let Crested Sunmare turn each turn you gained life into a fresh 5/5 indestructible Horse.
plan: Seraphic Steed or Sungrace Pegasus: both have lifelink, so your attacks gain life from turn 3.
Celestial Unicorn or Good-Fortune Unicorn; Splendor Mare adds more lifelink. Path to Exile their best blocker.
Inspiring Unicorn pumps the team on attack; Bill the Pony's Food is extra life. Crested Sunmare lands.
Gain life each turn for a new 5/5 Horse, saddle Seraphic Steed for Angels, and swing with the herd.
keys: At each end step you gained life, make a 5/5 Horse. Other Horses (tokens, Bill, Guardian Sunmare) are indestructible.
+1/+1 counter every time you gain life.
Every other creature (and token) you play enters with a +1/+1 counter.
First strike and lifelink for two; saddled, it makes a 3/3 flying Angel each attack.
Saddled attacks fetch any permanent with mana value 3 or less from your library onto the battlefield.
tips: Saddle (Seraphic Steed 4, Guardian Sunmare 4): tap other creatures with total power 4 or more at sorcery speed; the Mount then attacks saddled.
Crested Sunmare checks at each end step, yours and the opponent's: gaining life on their turn (lifelink blockers, Food) also makes a Horse.
Bill the Pony's Food: {2}, tap, sacrifice: gain 3 life. That triggers Celestial Unicorn and Crested Sunmare. Or sacrifice one so a creature deals damage equal to its toughness.
Shepherd of the Clouds returns a dead card with mana value 3 or less straight to the battlefield if you control a Mount.
Regal Bunnicorn counts all your nonland permanents, including Food and tokens.
Cycle Splendor Mare for {1}{W} to put a lifelink counter on your biggest creature.
mulligan: Keep 2–4 lands with both colors (or a Windswept Heath) and at least one two-drop pony.
sideboard: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, Damping Sphere
